# Library/Packages

# Data dan Eksplorasi Awal
```{r}
data<-read.csv("D:/Kuliah/Semester 5/Metode Peramalan Deret Waktu/SN_d_tot_V2.0.csv", sep=";")
colnames(data)<-c("Tahun", "Bulan", "Hari", "Desimal", "Sunspot", "SD", "Obs", "Def")
data <- subset(data, (Tahun > 1926 | (Tahun == 1926 & Bulan >= 1)) & (Tahun < 2025 | (Tahun == 2025 & Bulan <= 12)))
data
```
```{r}
summary(data$Sunspot)
```
```{r}
colSums(is.na(data))
```
```{r}
plot(data$Desimal, data$Sunspot, 
     type = "l", col = "gray50", 
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Sunspot", 
     main = "Plot Data Mentah Sunspot (1926 - 2025)")
```
```{r}
data_bulanan <- aggregate(Sunspot ~ Tahun + Bulan, data = data, FUN = mean)
data_bulanan <- data_bulanan[order(data_bulanan$Tahun, data_bulanan$Bulan), ]
ts_bulanan <- ts(data_bulanan$Sunspot, start = c(1926, 1), frequency = 12)
```

```{r}
plot(ts_bulanan, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Bulanan Sunspot (Januari 1926 - Desember 2025)")
```
```{r}
data_tahunan <- aggregate(Sunspot ~ Tahun, data = data, FUN = mean)
ts_tahunan <- ts(data_tahunan$Sunspot, start = 1926, frequency = 1)
plot(ts_tahunan, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Tahunan Sunspot (Januari 1926 - Desember 2025)")
```
```{r}
dec_sunspot <- decompose(ts_bulanan, type = "additive")
plot(dec_sunspot)
```
```{r}
seasonplot(ts_tahunan, 
           s = 11, 
           main = "Seasonal Plot of Sunspot (11-Year Cycle)", 
           ylab = "Jumlah Sunspot",
           xlab = "Tahun ke- dalam Siklus",
           year.labels = TRUE, 
           col = rainbow(10), 
           pch = 19)
```

```{r}
monthplot(ts_bulanan, ylab = "Sunspot (ppm)", col = "darkblue", 
          main = "Monthplot Data Sunspot")
```
```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = as.factor(Tahun), y = Sunspot)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "orange", color = "black", outlier.size = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, size = 8)) +
  labs(title = "Sebaran Sunspot Bulanan per Tahun",
       x = "Tahun",
       y = "Jumlah Sunspot")
```

# Pembagian Training dan Testing Data
```{r}
ts_sunspot<-ts_tahunan
n_total <- length(ts_sunspot)
n_test <- 20
n_train <- n_total - n_test

train_data <- window(ts_sunspot, end = time(ts_sunspot)[n_train])
test_data <- window(ts_sunspot, start = time(ts_sunspot)[n_train + 1])
```
```{r}
plot(train_data, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Training")
```
```{r}
plot(test_data, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Testing")
```

```{r}
min(train_data)
```


# Uji Stasioneritas
## Uji Fligner-Killeen
```{r}
data$Periode <- cut(data$Tahun, 
                         breaks = c(1925, 1950, 1975, 2000, 2025), 
                         labels = c("1926-1950", "1951-1975", "1976-2000", "2001-2025"))

fligner.test(Sunspot ~ Periode, data = data)
```
## Uji ADF
```{r}
tseries::adf.test(train_data)
```
# Penanganan Ragam Tidak Stasioner
```{r}
train_log <- log(train_data)
test_log <- log(test_data)

plot.ts(train_log, type="l", col="black", main="Plot Data Log(Sunspot)")
```
```{r}
tseries::adf.test(train_log)
```
```{r}
df_log <- data.frame(
  Tahun = as.numeric(time(train_log)),
  Sunspot_Log = as.numeric(train_log)
)

df_log$Periode <- cut(df_log$Tahun, 
                      breaks = 4, 
                      labels = c("Periode 1", "Periode 2", "Periode 3", "Periode 4"))

fligner.test(Sunspot_Log ~ Periode, data = df_log)
```

# Non-Seasonal
## ACF
```{r}
acf(train_log, lag.max = 55)
```

## PACF
```{r}
pacf(train_log, lag.max = 55)
```
Tanpa differencing karena stasioner dalam rataan (d=0). PACF cut off, indikasi AR(2) (p=2). ACF tails off, indikasi MA(0) (q=0). 
# Seasonal 
## Lag 11
### Differencing
```{r}
D1 <- diff(train_log, lag = 11) 
plot.ts(D1, lty=1, xlab="Waktu", ylab="Data Difference Seasonal 1 Sunspot", main="Plot Difference Seasonal")
```
Indikasi D=1, s=11.
### ACF setelah differencing musiman
```{r}
acf(D1, lag.max = 55, main = "ACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 11")
```
ACF cut off setelah lag musiman, indikasi Seasonal MA (Q=1 atau Q=0). Indikasi q=1.
### PACF setelah differencing
```{r}
pacf(D1, lag.max = 55, main = "PACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 11")
```
PACF tails off di lag musiman dan kelipatannya, indikasi Seasonal AR (P=1). Indikasi p=1 atau p=2.

## Lag 5
### Differencing
```{r}
D2 <- diff(train_log, lag = 5) 
plot.ts(D2, lty=1, xlab="Waktu", ylab="Data Difference Seasonal 1 Sunspot", main="Plot Difference Seasonal")
```
### ACF setelah differencing
```{r}
acf(D2, lag.max = 55, main = "ACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 5")
```
Hasil differencing berkali2 tetap membuat ACF di lag 5 dan kelipatannya melewati garis putus.

### PACF setelah differencing
```{r}
pacf(D2, lag.max = 55, main = "PACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 5")
```
Indikasi P=1.

)

# Diagnostik Model
## Visual
```{r}
sisaan <- residuals(model6)
plot(sisaan, main = "Data Log(Sunspot)", ylab = "Log", xlab = "Tahun")
acf(sisaan, main = "ACF", lag.max = 55)
pacf(sisaan, main = "PACF", lag.max = 55)
```
```{r}
car::qqPlot(sisaan)
plot(c(1:length(sisaan)),sisaan)
acf(sisaan)
pacf(sisaan)
```
## Uji Formal
### Sisaan menyebar normal

```{r}
shapiro.test(sisaan)
```

```{r}
fitted_log <- fitted(model6)
fitted_asli <- exp(fitted_log)
aktual_asli <- as.numeric(train_data) 
sisaan_asli <- aktual_asli - fitted_asli
shapiro.test(sisaan_asli)
```
```{r}
lambda_optimal <- BoxCox.lambda(train_data) 
print(lambda_optimal) 

model_boxcox <- Arima(train_data, 
                      order = c(1,0,1), 
                      seasonal = list(order = c(0,1,1), period = 11),
                      lambda = lambda_optimal) 

shapiro.test(residuals(model_boxcox))
```


### Sisaan saling bebas
```{r}
Box.test(sisaan, type = "Ljung", lag=22) 
```
```{r}
Box.test(sisaan_asli, type = "Ljung", lag=22) 
```

### Sisaan memiliki ragam homogen
```{r}
Box.test((sisaan)^2, type = "Ljung", lag=22)  
```
```{r}
Box.test((sisaan_asli)^2, type = "Ljung", lag=22)  
```
### Nilai harapan sama dengan nol
```{r}
t.test(sisaan, mu = 0, conf.level = 0.95) 
```
```{r}
t.test(sisaan_asli, mu = 0, conf.level = 0.95) 
```

# Plot asli
```{r}
tahun_awal <- 1926
tahun_akhir_historis <- 2005 
tahun_akhir_ramalan <- tahun_akhir_historis + length(ramalan_sarima$mean)

prediksi_asli <- exp(ramalan_sarima$mean)
batas_bawah   <- exp(ramalan_sarima$lower[, 2])
batas_atas    <- exp(ramalan_sarima$upper[, 2])

plot(ts_sunspot, type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlim = c(tahun_awal, tahun_akhir_ramalan),
     ylim = c(0, max(ts_sunspot, batas_atas) + 30),
     main = "Peramalan Sunspot (1926 - Masa Depan)",
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Jumlah Sunspot")

tahun_ramalan <- (tahun_akhir_historis + 1):tahun_akhir_ramalan

polygon(c(tahun_ramalan, rev(tahun_ramalan)),
        c(batas_bawah, rev(batas_atas)),
        col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.2), border = NA)

lines(tahun_ramalan, prediksi_asli, col = "blue", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

abline(v = tahun_akhir_historis, col = "red", lty = 3, lwd = 2)

legend("topleft", 
       legend = c("Data Aktual", "Prediksi", "Batas 95%", "Akhir Data Train"),
       col = c("black", "blue", "blue", "red"), 
       lty = c(1, 2, 1, 3), lwd = c(1.5, 2, 10, 2),
       fill = c(NA, NA, rgb(0,0,1,0.2), NA), border = NA, bty = "n")
```
```{r}
aktual <- as.numeric(test_data)
prediksi <- as.numeric(prediksi_asli)

tabel_prediksi <- data.frame(
  No = 1:length(aktual),
  Aktual = aktual,
  Prediksi = prediksi,
  Error = aktual - prediksi
)

tabel_prediksi
```

```{r}
accuracy(prediksi_asli,test_data)
```
```{r}
aktual_test <- as.numeric(test_data)
prediksi_test <- as.numeric(prediksi_asli)
mae_model <- mean(abs(aktual_test - prediksi_test))
naive_errors <- diff(as.numeric(train_data))
mae_naive <- mean(abs(naive_errors))
mase <- mae_model / mae_naive

cat("MASE :", mase, "\n")
```
```{r}
pembilang <- abs(aktual_test - prediksi_test)
penyebut <- (abs(aktual_test) + abs(prediksi_test)) / 2
smape <- mean(pembilang / penyebut) * 100

cat("SMAPE :", smape, "%\n")
```

```{r}
arah_aktual <- ifelse(diff(aktual_test) > 0, 1, 0)
arah_prediksi <- ifelse(diff(prediksi_test) > 0, 1, 0)

mda <- mean(arah_aktual == arah_prediksi) * 100
cat("MDA :", mda, "%\n")
```
```{r}
korelasi <- cor(aktual_test, prediksi_test)
cat("Korelasi :", korelasi, "\n")
```
```{r}
naive_seasonal_errors <- diff(as.numeric(train_data), lag = 11)
mae_naive_seasonal <- mean(abs(naive_seasonal_errors))

mase_seasonal <- mae_model / mae_naive_seasonal
cat("MASE (Seasonal Naive) :", mase_seasonal, "\n")
```
# Model TBATS
## Model pertama
```{r}
model_tbats <- tbats(
  y = train_data, 
  seasonal.periods = 11
)

summary(model_tbats)

```
```{r}
model_tbats
```


```{r}
ramalan_tbats <- forecast::forecast(model_tbats, h = 20)
ramalan_tbats
```


```{r}
plot(ramalan_tbats, main = "Peramalan TBATS untuk Sunspot Tahunan")
lines(test_data, col = "red") 
```
```{r}
accuracy(ramalan_tbats, test_data)
```
```{r}
sisaan_tbats<-residuals(model_tbats)
plot(sisaan_tbats, main = "Plot Sisaan TBATS", ylab = "Error")
acf(sisaan_tbats, lag.max = 60, main = "ACF Sisaan TBATS")
```
```{r}
shapiro.test(sisaan_tbats)
```

```{r}
t.test(sisaan_tbats, mu = 0)
```
```{r}
Box.test(sisaan_tbats, type = "Ljung-Box", lag=22)
```
```{r}
Box.test((sisaan_tbats)^2, type = "Ljung", lag=22)  
```
```{r}
checkresiduals(model_tbats)
```
## Model kedua
```{r}
model_tbats_coba <- tbats(train_data, seasonal.periods = c(11, 5.5))
checkresiduals(model_tbats_coba)
sisaan_coba<-residuals(model_tbats_coba)
shapiro.test(sisaan_coba)
t.test(sisaan_coba, mu=0)
Box.test(sisaan_coba, lag=22, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(sisaan_coba, lag=11, type="Ljung-Box")
Box.test((sisaan_coba)^2, lag=22, type="Ljung")
Box.test((sisaan_coba)^2, lag=11, type="Ljung")
```
## Perbandingan
```{r}
ramalan_A <- forecast::forecast(model_tbats, h = length(test_data))
akurasi_A <- accuracy(ramalan_A, test_data)

ramalan_B <- forecast::forecast(model_tbats_coba, h = length(test_data))
akurasi_B <- accuracy(ramalan_B, test_data)

cat("=== MODEL A (s=11) ===\n")
print(akurasi_A[2, c("RMSE", "MAE", "MASE")])

cat("\n=== MODEL B (s=11 dan 5.5) ===\n")
print(akurasi_B[2, c("RMSE", "MAE", "MASE")])
```
